subject: Compact multi-slot loop: sequencing, evaluator pairs, and post-loop notes
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@example.com>
Cc: Emily Rhodes <emily@talentworks.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact virtual loop proposal + quick logistics

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time to meet with us. We want to run a compact virtual full-loop (4 slots) to keep things efficient while giving you room to demonstrate systems design and product thinking. Below is the proposed sequencing and approximate durations — all virtual on Zoom. Can you confirm availability for the times listed or share alternate 2-hour windows?

Proposed loop (PST):
- 09:30–10:00 — Hiring manager deep-dive (Karthik Iyer) — systems/product mix
- 10:10–10:40 — Design & architecture (Laura Bennett) — whiteboard prompt
- 10:50–11:20 — Team fit / cross-functional (Marissa Cole) — behavioral + collaboration
- 11:30–12:00 — Live system debugging / take-home discussion (panel)

We keep 10-minute cushions between slots for bathroom/tech and a short recap. Attached is your resume (we have the latest PDF) and our evaluation rubric so you know what each interviewer will score.

If that works, I’ll send calendar invites and a single debrief doc for the interviewers to use — will ask Marissa to host the post-loop sync (15 minutes) for immediate notes.

Quick asks:
- Confirm Sam’s timezone is PST (you are in SF, right?)
- Any accommodations we should know about for the live exercise?

Thanks — look forward to confirming.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
Olga@redwood.com

Attachments: Sam_Carter_Resume.pdf (PDF, 240KB); evaluation_rubric_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 86KB)
From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@example.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Rhodes <emily@talentworks.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 13:43:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Compact virtual loop proposal + quick logistics

Hi Olga —

Thanks — that plan looks good. Confirming: I’m in PST (SF). All four slots work for me except the 10:50–11:20 slot — I have a short call that day that can’t move.

Availability windows I can offer instead (PST):
- 08:30–10:30 (open)
- 11:40–13:30 (open)

No special accommodations needed. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Sam

Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Compact virtual loop proposal + quick logistics (Sam Carter)

Folks — forwarding Sam’s note. He’s PST and can do the earlier window or later afternoon; he cannot make the 10:50–11:20 slot. Proposed final schedule (PST) below — please confirm if you can cover assigned slots. I adjusted sequencing to preserve the behavioral slot earlier so that team fit happens before the deep technical panel.

Final proposed (PST) — please ACK or propose swaps by EOD:
- 09:00–09:30 — Hiring manager + product (Karthik Iyer) — lead
- 09:40–10:10 — Team fit / cross-functional (Marissa Cole) — lead
- 10:20–10:50 — Design & architecture (Laura Bennett) — lead
- 11:00–11:30 — Live debugging / take-home discussion (Laura + Karthik) — panel

Notes:
- We tightened the windows to 30 minutes each and moved start earlier to accommodate Sam’s calendar.
- Laura, the last slot is a panel with you and Karthik — we’ll ask tech triage questions and then discuss the take-home.
- Marissa, can you host the 15-minute immediate debrief at 11:40–11:55? I’ll create the Doc with the rubric and a one-click scoring table.

Attachments: Sam_Carter_Resume.pdf; evaluation_rubric_v2.xlsx

Thanks —
Olga

Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Compact virtual loop proposal + quick logistics (Sam Carter)

Thanks for the ping — I can take the 09:40–10:10 team-fit slot and will run the debrief at 11:40 as requested. A couple small asks:

- Can we move the 11:00–11:30 panel to 11:10–11:40 so our debrief window stays at 11:50–12:05? That gives us a 10-minute buffer after the panel.
- Could we flip the order of design and team-fit if Laura prefers the whiteboard earlier? My preference is to have team-fit second so the candidate can relax into the loop before the longer architecture slot, but I'm flexible.

Also — Laura, Karthik: I recommend the live debugging prompt be one focused API + latency trade-offs (15 min coding / 10 min discussion) so we can compare apples-to-apples with prior candidates. I’ll attach a short prompt to the doc once confirmed.

All good on my end — I can do design at 10:20 and the panel at 11:00 as originally proposed. I prefer to keep design after team-fit (Marissa’s suggestion) so Sam has context. The 10-minute buffers are important to avoid overruns — please keep them.

One operational note: I’ll drop the whiteboard prompt (2 slides + 1 open-ended system sketch) into the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xqCompactLoopPrep — please don’t share with the candidate in advance. Also adding a short checklist for interviewers (timekeeping, scoring quick links).

Marissa — agree on the API/latency prompt for live debugging. Karthik — want to own the first 10 minutes of the panel to poke at trade-offs, then I’ll run the take-home discussion.

See you in the loop.

Laura

Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2029 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Compact loop scheduled + debrief & interviewer notes

Hi all —

Thanks for the fast replies. Final schedule (PST) and calendar invites have been sent — shareable link below. Sam, we set the loop for tomorrow (Sat) per your earlier window: 09:00–11:30 PST with the slots as discussed. Please join via the Zoom link on the calendar event.

Final (PST):
- 09:00–09:30 — Hiring manager + product (Karthik Iyer)
- 09:40–10:10 — Team fit / cross-functional (Marissa Cole)
- 10:20–10:50 — Design & architecture (Laura Bennett)
- 11:00–11:30 — Live debugging / take-home discussion (Laura + Karthik)
- 11:40–11:55 — Immediate debrief (Marissa host)

What interviewers should bring:
- A score (1–5) prepped for each rubric category in the Doc (link below)
- Two quick notes: one strength, one risk
- Timekeeping: if a slot runs long, flag it in the chat and we’ll skip the 10-minute buffer to keep the next day’s calendar intact

Links:
- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123compactloop
- Prep folder & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xqCompactLoopPrep
- Debrief doc (edit for interviewers): https://docs.google.com/document/d/compact-loop-debrief

Sam — no homework changes; Laura will run a 15-minute whiteboard prompt and we’ll spend 15 minutes on the take-home + probing questions. If anything unexpected comes up, reply-all and we’ll triage.

See you tomorrow, and thanks everyone for the quick coordination.

Best,
Olga
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
